description: Create a short link on opn.onl. Supports scheduling, click limits, folders, tags and one-time (burn-after-reading) links. Returns the short URL and its code.

alias.description: Custom alias / slug (optional). Use check_alias_available first to avoid collisions.

burn_after_reading.description: One-time link: destroy it after the first successful visit (optional)

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which the link stops working (optional)

folder_id.description: Place the link in this folder id (optional)

max_clicks.description: Deactivate the link after this many clicks (optional)

safe_link_interstitial.description: Show a safety interstitial page before redirecting (optional)

starts_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp before which the link is inactive (optional)

tag_ids.description: Tag ids to attach to the link (optional)

name: shorten_url
